text:
anna: Quick triage on embeddings API before roadmap sync. Customers pushing large batch loads + mixed-dim vectors. Need a clear ship plan for shape + billing.

ryan: short take: mixed dims in one request = pain. Index stores expect consistent vector size; also blows up batching kernels. Strong prefer 1 dim per request.

chi: ops perspective 10: if we commit to 4096 and 2048 as initial dims, memory math works nicely on our T4/80GB fleet. 8192 is doable but only with small batch sizes.

mira: product: customers want a single endpoint that "just works". Prefer server to accept variable-length inputs (text) and return normalized vectors. For explicit vector uploads (clients sending their own vectors), we need validation & clear errors.

ben: security/quotas: require hard per-request limits to prevent noisy neighbors. Also need per-tenant reserved qps tiers that map to Dedicated/Private SLAs.

anna: proposal: Phase A (GA target): dims = [2048, 4096], uniform-dim per request, batch caps = {2048 vectors @2048-dim, 256 vectors @4096-dim}. Phase B: add 8192 with strict cap 64 vectors and optional dedicated nodes. Phase C: variable-dim negotiation (long term).

ryan: implementation detail: expose header `Embed-Dim: 4096` (or query param). Avoid server autodetect - it complicates routing & cache keys.

chi: agree on header. Also need to return `server_dim` in response metadata so clients can sanity check.

mira: sample response payload (SDK-friendly):
```json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-2026",
  "server_dim": 4096,
  "embeddings": [
    {"id": "row-1", "vector": [0.12, -0.03, ...]},
    {"id": "row-2", "vector": [0.01, 0.99, ...]}
  ],
  "billing_units": 16,
  "warnings": []
}
```

ben: billing note: charge by (dim / 256) * vectors rounded up -> billing_units. Need legal to sign off.

anna: on client ergonomics: SDK should offer helpers: pad/truncate, upsample/downsample (best-effort with warning), and a validation layer that rejects a mix of dims in a single call.

ryan: runtime change: batching kernel selection keyed by (model, server_dim) and batch_size. So pinning dim in request header is essential for cache-friendly routing.

chi: perf targets: p95 <= 120ms for 2048-dim at batch 256, p95 <= 220ms for 4096-dim at batch 64. We'll need to run stress tests on dedicated nodes to validate.

mira: launch checklist idea: 1) API schema + header doc, 2) SDK helpers + migration guide, 3) billing spec, 4) stress test results, 5) opt-in beta for 10 customers.

ben: runbook items: throttle behavior when tenant exceeds reserved throughput, fallbacks (queue vs reject), and audit logs for billing disputes.

anna: decide now? Recommend we lock Phase A dims 2048/4096, require uniform-dim per request, header pin, and batch caps as above. Phase B (8192) gated on perf & pricing.

ryan: +1 to that. Keeps scope manageable.

chi: +1. I'll schedule perf runs and post numbers by EOD tomorrow.

mira: i'll draft the product spec & SDK tasks and open a beta invite list. tagging @anna @ryan for review. :sparkles:

deploy-bot: scheduled job: embeddings-canary-2048-4096 queued for Sat 01:30 UTC.

anna: thanks team 10. I'll update the roadmap doc and create the PR for the API spec.
